rationale: Identity was properly verified using full name and zip. The agent located the correct pending order and correctly presented variant options. After explicit user confirmation, the agent modified the backpack and desk lamp to the correct variants and the prices and payment delta (19.24) match the tool outputs. However, the user also requested changing the shipping address to the default Charlotte address. The agent neither attempted nor completed the address change, and instead claimed that shipping address changes are not possible after item modifications—a restriction not supported by the provided tools or policy summary. Moreover, the agent should have addressed the shipping change first or at least attempted it before item modifications. While the agent did obtain confirmation for the item changes, they did not complete the full requested action and provided an unsupported rationale for why the address could not be changed. Therefore, the request was not fully completed in line with policy, and final information about address-change limitations appears fabricated/unsupported.
